Privacy Policy

Terms & ConditionsPrivacy PolicyCookie PolicyShipping & DeliveryRefunds & SubscriptionsAccessibilityVersion 2026-10-16

This policy explains how Eternaluxe collects, uses, shares, retains, and protects personal information when people browse the site, enquire, subscribe, or purchase.

Information we may collect

Orders and fulfillment

Name, contact details, billing and delivery information, recipient details, purchase history, delivery instructions, and transaction status. Full payment-card details should be handled by the payment processor and not stored by Eternaluxe.

Enquiries and bespoke work

Project type, date, location, budget range, palette, scale, inspiration files, communications, and information a customer chooses to provide.

Newsletter and preferences

Email address, marketing choice, unsubscribe history, and communication engagement where enabled and lawfully configured.

Website and device data

Necessary technical data and, only according to the visitor’s choices and applicable law, analytics, preference, or advertising identifiers. The production audit must list each cookie and script.

Consent evidence

Order or submission ID, policy names and versions, immutable version identifiers or hashes, checkbox states, UTC timestamp, form source, and only the minimum technical evidence counsel considers necessary. Preference withdrawals should be new events, not destructive edits to prior records.

Why we use information

Uses may include processing orders, arranging delivery, responding to enquiries, providing subscriptions, preventing fraud, maintaining records, meeting legal duties, improving the service with consented analytics, and sending marketing only where permission or another valid basis exists.

How information is shared

Information may be disclosed to service providers necessary for hosting, ecommerce, payments, customer communication, delivery, professional advice, security, and analytics selected by the visitor. The final policy must name or accurately categorize every actual recipient and explain any sale, sharing, or targeted-advertising practice. Eternaluxe should not claim that data is never sold or shared until the audit supports that statement.

Retention

Keep information only as long as needed for the relevant service, accounting, tax, dispute, fraud-prevention, or legal purpose. The final schedule should state verified periods for orders, enquiries, marketing records, analytics, consent evidence, and uploaded files. When no longer needed, delete or de-identify information using documented procedures.

Choices and requests

People may unsubscribe from marketing at any time and change optional cookie choices through “Cookie settings” in the footer. Depending on residence and applicable law, they may also have rights to access, correct, delete, obtain, or restrict certain use of personal information, and to appeal a decision. Submit a request to the Contact Us page. Eternaluxe may take proportionate steps to verify identity.

Security

Eternaluxe should use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the information involved. No system is completely secure; the final policy should not promise absolute security.

Children

The services are not directed to children under 13, and Eternaluxe does not knowingly collect their personal information. If this statement is inaccurate for any service, counsel must revise it and the product design before launch.

International use and transfers

This draft assumes primary U.S. operations. Before intentionally serving other jurisdictions, review local disclosures, lawful bases, transfer mechanisms, consumer rights, and consent requirements.

Updates and contact

Material revisions will receive a new effective date and version. The final policy must identify the responsible legal entity and postal address. Privacy questions and requests: the Contact Us page.

Local preview and configured deployment

In local preview, forms save to the local server only; they do not contact Eternaluxe or subscribe you to a mailing platform. A configured production deployment records enquiry details separately from consent evidence. The application does not persist raw IP addresses or full payment-card details. Retention, connected vendors and the consumer-request contact must be finalized before publication.
